title: Critical Zeros and Unconditional Mean Value Theorems for twisted $\hbox{PGL}(2)$ and $\hbox{PGL}(3)$ $\mathrm{L}$-functions
summary: Let $Π_{0}$ be a cuspidal automorphic representation of $\mathrm{PGL}_{3}(\mathbb{A}_{\mathbb{Q}})$. In this paper, we use Levinson's method to prove that, as $Q\to \infty$, at least $1/9$ of the zeros of the $L$-functions $L(s, Π_{0}\,\times\, χ)$ lie on the critical line, where $χ$ ranges over the family of primitive Dirichlet characters of conductor up to $Q$. This result is unconditional when $Π_{0}$ is self-dual, and otherwise holds under a mild condition.
